हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Chuppi is a dark psychological thriller about a woman trapped in an abusive marriage with a powerful ACP. After escaping and starting a new life under a false identity, Aarohi finds hope and healing, until her past hunts her down. The series is a haunting exploration of silence, survival, and the courage to finally speak up. Watch now!
